conference: NAMD Fall Conference (National Association of Medicaid Directors)
source_note: A 2025 sponsor page exists and is public - the conference sitemap (https://events.medicaiddirectors.org/wp-sitemap-posts-page-1.xml, read from the Wayback snapshot of 2025-10-02) lists BOTH /sponsor-exhibitor/2025-sponsors/ and /sponsor-exhibitor/draft-2025-sponsors/, and a search engine has indexed the second under the title 'NAMD Fall 2025 Conference Sponsors | NAMD'. Neither page could be read. This is a read failure, NOT evidence that the list is absent.
why: The whole events.medicaiddirectors.org host answers every request - pages, wp-json, sitemap, even static PDFs and images - with HTTP 202, header 'SG-Captcha: challenge', and a 210-byte meta-refresh to /.well-known/sgcaptcha/; a real Chrome session lands on a 'Robot Challenge Screen' that never clears, and defeating a bot check is off limits. The list is not archived anywhere: the Wayback CDX index holds 1,694 URLs for that host and zero captures of 2025-sponsors, draft-2025-sponsors or 2024-sponsors (its newest sponsor page is 2023), archive.today has one 2017 capture of the site root and nothing else, and Save Page Now returned 520. Sponsor pages for 2016-2023 ARE archived and readable, so the pattern is retrievable for older editions but not this one. No third party republishes the roster: NAMD's main site (medicaiddirectors.org) has no sponsor page and its 2025 event page now redirects to the 2026 edition, ADvancing States only reprints NAMD's sponsorship-sales blurb, and the aggregator listings (eventsxpo, 10times) are themselves behind a CAPTCHA or a 403. Individual vendors published their own NAMD 2025 attendance pages (Gainwell Technologies, Acentra Health, Altarum, UnitedHealthcare Community & State, BerryDunn, Maximus, CAQH, PPL) - real evidence each was there, but a scrape of self-announcements is not the exhibitor list and is not recorded here as one.
